name: Capella Ab
tagline: Le jumeau — le second géant doré du couple de Capella, valsant tous les 104 jours.

facts.label: Orbite
facts.value: ~0.74 AU from Capella Aa — 104-day period, e≈0.001

facts.label: Rayon
facts.value: ~9 R☉ — about nine times the Sun

facts.label: Système
facts.value: A quartet — the giants plus a far red-dwarf pair

history: Capella Ab is the slightly lighter half of the sky's most famous twin giants — two near-identical G stars circling each other on an orbit so circular it is effectively a perfect ring, swept through every 104 days. So close that even Hubble barely separates them; their mutual orbit was charted by interferometry. Both stars have evolved off the main sequence into swollen yellow giants — a matched pair showing stellar evolution running in step. A remote red-dwarf double orbits far beyond, making Capella a true quartet.
